text: I'm so sorry to message at this hour, I know you must be busy with poorly children and this probably isn't urgent at all. My granddaughter Mia is 3 and staying with me this week. Her eczema has flared right up, dry rough patches on the backs of her knees and inside her elbows and she keeps scratching at them. I've put her usual cream on but she's still itchy and fidgeting. I just didn't know if there's anything else I can do tonight or if it should wait for her mum to take her to the GP. Sorry again for bothering you.
